description: Manage projects, firms, contacts and activities in Deltek Vantagepoint, look up employees, and follow new and changed records.

deltek_vantagepoint_activity_updated_tri.description: Runs when an activity is logged or changed, such as being marked completed.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

deltek_vantagepoint_contact_updated_trig.description: Runs when a contact is added or changed.

output.contact: The record returned by the service

deltek_vantagepoint_firm_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a firm is added or changed.

output.firm: The record returned by the service

deltek_vantagepoint_new_activity_trigger.description: Runs when a meeting, call, email or task is logged.

output.activity: The record returned by the service

deltek_vantagepoint_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a contact is added.

output.contact: The record returned by the service

deltek_vantagepoint_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs when an employee is added.

output.employee: The record returned by the service

deltek_vantagepoint_new_firm_trigger.description: Runs when a client, vendor or consultant firm is added.

output.firm: The record returned by the service

deltek_vantagepoint_new_project_trigger.description: Runs when a project is added to the Projects hub.

output.project: The record returned by the service

deltek_vantagepoint_project_updated_trig.description: Runs when a project is added or changed, such as its status, stage, fee or manager.

output.project: The record returned by the service
